summary: Created phone number validation utility using libphonenumber-js that validates and formats phone numbers to E.164 standard. Supports automatic country detection from international format and explicit country code override via ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 parameter. Handles edge cases with fallback validation. Includes comprehensive test suite (51 tests) covering valid numbers from North America, Europe, Asia, Africa, Oceania, and South America, plus invalid input handling and country code validation.
